title: Move file_packet_provider into libwireshark
description:
Then the only shark_common files left are the files for supporting
extcaps in an application, so only add those to targets that support
extcap devices. Note those files depend on libwireshark (due to pref
support) and could only be moved there.

Run CheckAPI on the extcap support source.

Add a comment about perhaps making the extcap interface development
a shared library and a part of any SDK for out of tree builds.

AI-Assisted: no

notes.body: wireshark_flavor.c in wireshark_FILES, but stratoshark_flavor.c STRATOSHARK_SRC?
It should probably be in WIRESHARK_SRC so that the checkAPI script runs against it.
